etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Ancient Greek ἄμορφος (ámorphos, “without form, shapeless, deformed”) (itself from ἀ- (a-, “without”) + μορφή (morphḗ, “form”) +‎ -ous. By surface analysis, a- +‎ -morphous.
senses: Lacking a definite form or clear shape.
(by extension) Being without definite character or nature.
